src='''def transform(grid):
    rows = [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 2 for v in row)]
    cols = [j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if all(grid[i][j] == 2 for i in range(len(grid)))]
    rb = [-1] + rows + [len(grid)]
    cb = [-1] + cols + [len(grid[0])]
    out = []
    for a, b in zip(rb, rb[1:]):
        if b-a <= 1: continue
        line=[]
        for c,d in zip(cb,cb[1:]):
            if d-c <= 1: continue
            n=sum(grid[i][j] == 7 for i in range(a+1,b) for j in range(c+1,d))
            line.append(1 if n == 2 else 9)
        out.append(line)
    return out
'''
